about: builtRefreshParams(old, payload): the params a built widget's node keeps. Read by tests/test_slot_fill_built.py (slot_fill.refresh_params, the template fill) and app/src/pages/journal-2-0/lib/builtWidgets.vectors.test.js (the client). Expected values are typed by hand.

cases.name: a fill starts from nothing: the payload, share off
the member's current share switch is kept
nothing else is copied from the old params
a payload never turns sharing on
a truthy share that is not true is off
a payload that is not an object keeps only the switch
old params that are not an object read as none
